# Public registration fixtures

Both transaction graphs were constructed and executed with Namecoin Core28.0.0 in isolated regtest, using disposable authority derived from published BIP32 test vector1. The account public key and openings are public test data. No private key, production account, wallet file or RPC credential is included.

`core-graph.json` records actual Core unsigned transaction and PSBT bytes; both modes completed and confirmed exact name values. `signed-graph.json` retains Core's signed PSBTs, final transaction bytes and actual sizes. Public verification tests independently check each signature and reproduce the final transaction bytes, stable txids, weights and virtual sizes. Test execution never signs or contacts a node.

Phase manifests and reveal-value pins are immutable wire-v2 reference bytes. `wire-vectors.json` records eight exact request byte hashes, complete review frames and result-format examples. Request/sitting identifiers and journal metadata are synthetic format data, with no claim of owner presence or protected journal provenance. Completion requires separately authenticated history binding the completed SIGNED record to the complete result. Public parsing and matching acknowledgement hashes establish no such authentication. Protected signing, custody, chain membership and broadcast permission require separate checks.

The PSBT compatibility controls admit explicit version zero, SIGHASH_ALL, matching account global xpub/origin, omitted redundant witness UTXO, original funding witnesses and reordered maps. Each accepted original map entry must survive the signed response. The matching-global-xpub control is a public BIP174 construction; it is not a native signer qualification result. Unknown maps, missing full prevouts, altered origins or transactions, existing finalization fields, incomplete signatures, invalid DER, high-S and non-ALL signatures are rejected beside valid Core controls.

References: [Core nc28.0](https://github.com/namecoin/namecoin-core/tree/nc28.0), [BIP32 test vectors](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0032.mediawiki#test-vectors), [BIP143](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0143.mediawiki), [BIP174](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0174.mediawiki).
